Selects MTP-3 and seven-request admission from entity-shaped concurrency 2-8 sweeps; rejects MTP-1 after lower throughput and an eight-request clean-drain failure.

versions.notes: Original MiaAI-Lab EXL3/TR3 4bpw TP=2 profile with 900K context and no sidecar coexistence headroom.
Introduced the 262K coexistence profile using automatic KV sizing at 0.80 utilization.
Introduced explicit KV sizing but underprovisioned the hybrid GLM cache at 4.25 GiB.
Pins a measured 9.5 GiB FP8 hybrid KV pool for 262K context and uses a 0.79 fallback utilization so the Spark02 embedding lane can coexist without startup threshold jitter.

Refreshes to MiaAI 0e2e78f3 with DFlash2 padded slot-sharing, retained hybrid prefix hits, XGrammar speculative termination fixes, and stdout-safe overlays while preserving the measured 262K sidecar-coexistence memory envelope.
Uses IPv4 RoCE address-family discovery and merged-NIC handling without pinning a host-specific GID index, matching the proven two-Spark NCCL fabric path.
Makes GLM the explicit hard residency pin across both Sparks; delegated TP authority prevents worker-local displacement, while embeddings and image sidecars remain on-demand.
Adopts MiaAI's measured 2K prefill chunk and raises the served context to a practical 300 Ki tokens while retaining LLooM's 9.5 GiB KV budget and health headroom.
Adds stable glm53f local-first and cloud route profiles while preserving an explicit hidden local-only lane for attribution.
Matches MiaAI eb0469f with its locally compiled E2 prefill kernel, DFlash2 draft TP=2, MNBT 7168, and latest published 1M/rightsize validation profile while retaining stock quality controls.

versions.notes: Initial LLooM-managed official 0731 lane with the conservative 262K coexistence profile.
MiaAI-tested DSpark runtime with 262K context, measured coexistence headroom, and packaged tool, schema, reasoning-budget, and NVFP4 correctness fixes.
Replaces the withdrawn host-scanning thinking budget with MiaAI's GPU-resident opt-in implementation and adds reasoning stop-string and truncated-tool-call safety fixes.
Packages the pinned MiaAI source tree behind a checksum-verified manifest and keeps LLooM's serving profile as a separate policy overlay.
Pins MiaAI d1b76251, defaults the issue31 budget patch off, enables measured two-prefill concurrency and GB10 spin-wait fixes, and persists TileLang and Triton caches.
Matches MiaAI d1b76251's stable-default correctness, scheduler, and guarded performance backports while retaining LLooM's measured coexistence profile.
Passes MiaAI's explicit long-prefill chunk threshold into vLLM so deep concurrent-prompt scheduling can be measured and tuned.
Backports merged vLLM PR 52805 for MTP plus XGrammar termination safety and adds atomic distributed recovery with a three-minute no-progress watchdog.
Adds a same-ID local-first alias that falls through to the installed OpenRouter DeepSeek V4 Flash model during runtime upgrades and availability failures.
Backports the merged vLLM PR 51538 indexer clamp that prevents padded MTP context lengths from deadlocking the pinned Blackwell sparse top-k kernel.
Makes the local DS4F runtime request-driven and unpinned because its same-ID route has an installed OpenRouter fallback, while active requests still drain before eviction.
Makes the cloud-backed local DS4F runtime on-demand instead of keep-warm so higher-priority two-Spark runtimes can be admitted without a contradictory hard pin.
Adds a hidden dsv4f-local route with no cloud fallback so local-only benchmark attribution is enforceable.

Temporarily runs target-only decode to remove the speculative CUDA-graph padding shape behind recurrent three-request GPU-kernel stalls until the pinned image carries vLLM PR 51538's compiled top-k guard.

Restores DSpark speculative decode on a locally pinned image with vLLM PR 51538's compiled top-k guard, adopts MiaAI's safe single-prefill default and Issue 133 Triton specialization fix, and enables both RoCE rails with persistent compiler caches and NCCL flight recording.
Adds stable ds4f local-first and cloud route profiles plus an explicit hidden local-only lane, preserving the existing DeepSeek compatibility aliases.
